interventions: Every present opening closed independently, including closure of the final opening. No model recomputation after closure.

candidate_accounting.joint4_actual: 4 complete generated paths from one real K4-trained forward
candidate_accounting.joint4_prefix2_zero_adaptation: first 2 retained from the same 4 generated paths; charged 4, not a trained K2 baseline
candidate_accounting.reference_farthest_k2: privileged stored bank of R complete reference paths examined; 2 selected before closure; max C(R,2) pair checks, not K2 generation
candidate_accounting.reference_geometric_dpp_k2: same R bank, unit-quality RBF K2 MAP is exactly farthest pair; not an independent replication
candidate_accounting.reference_response_oracle_k2: same R bank and every closure outcome from exact privileged geometry; optimal fixed pair over all solvable closures; diagnostic upper bound within reference bank only

screening_rule: 5pp equal-parent AnyValid opportunity is only a cheap TRAIN falsification screen. Gap beyond geometric reference selection is principal; gap only versus unadapted prefix cannot support a new mechanism. Any retained opportunity requires a genuinely K2-trained saturation baseline before deciding a mechanism comparison.
reference_scope: complete finite opening-pair representatives in controlled geometry; not enumeration of all continuous trajectories or evidence about incomplete robot demonstrations
selection_ties: stable original reference-index lexicographic order; one pair selected per parent before a particular closure is revealed
no_solution_handling: Retain every closure and report its raw count, all-closure metric, and separate solvable-only equal-parent denominator; no fabricated failed learning target. Parents with zero solvable closures remain with null conditional metrics.
